author: Haroen Viaene
subject: fix(breadcrumb): guard against undefined facets (#5482)
bodyLines: If a breadcrumb widget gets "its" hierarchical menu added dynamically, there will be a render where getFacetValues returns `undefined`.
I checked, and all other cases of `getFacetValues` guard already for its result possibly being undefined.
Also added the common test for optimistic UI for breadcrumb, as it's a related fix.
* all swag is solved with more bling
